summary.text: Tom Charlton, listed by Ballotpedia as Thomas Charlton, is a Republican member of the Vermont House of Representatives for the Windsor-Windham District, which he has represented since January 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia says he was born in Vermont and has worked as a pastor.

sources.title: Vermont House of Representatives elections, 2026 - Ballotpedia
